summary: Authority bootstrap guards are fail-closed in form but not in execution order: both src/server/Bootstrap.server.luau and src/client/Bootstrap.client.luau obtain ReplicatedStorage, WaitForChild("UNRENDERED"), and require shared modules before asserting RunService:IsServer()/IsClient(); the server additionally requires PhysicsLabStudioHarness before its server-context assertion. A wrong-context bootstrap can therefore traverse dependency graphs or wait before authority rejection. PR #297 locks exact guard semantics and draft PR #300 locks deployment-folder separation, but neither locks this pre-import/pre-side-effect ordering. Follow up inside HG-BACKFILL-AUTHORITY after the overlapping PR sequence is integrated: move each context assertion immediately after acquiring RunService and before any WaitForChild/require/authority-sensitive work, then add a pure source-order regression that fails if a wait/require precedes the guard. Preserve server-owned Physics Lab startup and client exclusion of server-only modules. This is source-only hardening; no Studio or real two-client evidence is claimed.
evidence: Current main src/server/Bootstrap.server.luau executes ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild and requires Versions, SeedStream, and PhysicsLabStudioHarness before assert(RunService:IsServer(), "server bootstrap must run on server").
Current main src/client/Bootstrap.client.luau executes ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild and shared requires before assert(RunService:IsClient(), "client bootstrap must run on client").
PR #297 exact head 2a14f54ccecae5ea0e88f288f2c9185dbf885a9e tests exact guard form plus server-owned Physics Lab/client exclusion, not source ordering.
Authority test-adversary handoff for draft PR #300 b5fcd1d1ae6aa3c1dd762c20e15f4fc000f2f23c locks default.project.json deployment separation, not bootstrap guard ordering.
